specs.英文简介: The Davon Super-Microscope and Micro-Telescope are a number of outfits based on a quarter-plate bellows view camera, made (or at least patented) in 1920 by Frederick Nathaniel Davidson, an optician with a business at 140 and later 29 Great Portland Street, in central London.[https://worldwide.espacenet.com/patent/search?q=pn%3DGB164508A British Patent 164508], Improvements in or relating to camera
